title: S4 noise-law reanalysis of the saved paired noise-isolation records

argv: 2026-10-16: the user enabled the 12 m review reruns one at a time (noise-isolation-12m, e6-v3, e3-v3, e4-v3, e2-12m to new records; E5 skipped)

wls_on_seed_medians.note: weights borrowed from the seed SE of the mean; exploratory

wls_all_runs_block_se.note: chi2/dof far above one means the block errors do not describe the run-to-run scatter

floor_share_linear_fit.description: dV*N_e = alpha + beta/N_e (WLS, seed SE); model: sigma2*N_e = a + b/N_e (OLS)
floor_share_linear_fit.interpretation: beta/alpha (electrons) is the flux at which the measured additive floor equals the photon term; compare with the model's b/a

gate_free_subset.criterion: every run of both arms has a mean valid fraction >= 0.999

invalid_row_frames.note: row-frames = (1 - mean valid fraction) x rows x analysed frames; a lenslet contributes two rows

seed_paired_bootstrap_unweighted.estimator: OLS slope of log(seed-mean dV) vs log N_e, unweighted; whole-seed resampling
seed_paired_bootstrap_unweighted.caveat: resamples of the saved aggregates; not new realizations
